steps: Verify Bob's account has sufficient balance of at least 100 rubles.
Authenticate Bob's identity using his PIN or biometric data.
Confirm Linda's account details (account number and name) are correct.
Initiate a fund transfer of 100 rubles from Bob's account to Linda's account.
Record the transaction in both accounts with timestamp and reference ID.
Send confirmation notifications to both Bob and Linda via SMS and app alert.
